WITH RECURSIVE owned_todos AS (
), matching AS ( SELECT uuid FROM owned_todos WHERE (strt_dt IS NULL AND due_dt IS NULL) OR (COALESCE(due_dt, strt_dt) >= #{fromDate} AND COALESCE(strt_dt, due_dt) <= #{toDate}) ), visible(uuid) AS ( SELECT uuid FROM matching UNION SELECT parent.uuid FROM visible child JOIN owned_todos current ON current.uuid = child.uuid JOIN owned_todos parent ON parent.uuid = current.prnt_todo_uuid AND parent.work_unit_uuid = current.work_unit_uuid ) SELECT t.*, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matching m WHERE m.uuid = t.uuid) AS context_only FROM owned_todos t JOIN visible v ON v.uuid = t.uuid ORDER BY t.work_unit_ttl, t.work_unit_uuid, t.sort_ord, t.created_at, t.idx LIMIT 2001

WITH owned_todos AS (
) SELECT work_unit_uuid, work_unit_ttl AS ttl, work_unit_sts AS sts, work_unit_use_yn AS use_yn, MIN(COALESCE(strt_dt, due_dt)) AS strt_dt, MAX(COALESCE(due_dt, strt_dt)) AS due_dt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE strt_dt IS NULL OR due_dt IS NULL) AS partial_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE leaf) AS total_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE leaf AND todo_group = 'TODAY') AS today_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE leaf AND todo_group = 'UPCOMING') AS upcoming_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE leaf AND todo_group = 'OVERDUE') AS overdue_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE leaf AND todo_group = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE leaf AND todo_group = 'UNSCHEDULED') AS unscheduled_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE leaf AND todo_group = 'COMPLETED' AND cmpl_at IS NULL) AS unknown_completion_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE leaf AND todo_group = 'COMPLETED' AND cmpl_at >= #{fromInstant} AND cmpl_at < #{beforeInstant}) AS period_completed_count FROM owned_todos GROUP BY work_unit_uuid, work_unit_ttl, work_unit_sts, work_unit_use_yn ORDER BY work_unit_ttl, work_unit_uuid

SELECT CAST(date_trunc(#{bucket}, cmpl_at AT TIME ZONE #{timeZone}) AS DATE) AS bucket_start, COUNT(*) AS completed_count FROM leaf_todos WHERE sts = 'DONE' AND cmpl_at >= #{fromInstant} AND cmpl_at < #{beforeInstant} GROUP BY bucket_start ORDER BY bucket_start
